ev.q: During October 2023–August 2024, 70% of COVID-19–associated hospitalizations were among adults aged ≥65 years
The 2023–2024 COVID-19 vaccines provided approximately 50% (95% CI = 44%–55%) additional protection against hospitalization
ACIP recommended that all persons aged ≥65 years receive a second dose
ACIP evaluated published assessments of vaccine effectiveness (VE) and safety of previous COVID-19 vaccine formulations
